verdict.rationale: Teller's own docs describe registrable outbound webhooks: you supply a URL in your app that Teller calls, and Teller sends events when enrollments or financial data change. That is a genuine product-provided HTTP callback mechanism. However, registration is documented only through the Teller Dashboard, not programmatically, and the pack does not enumerate event types or describe delivery guarantees, so coverage of the story is incomplete. missing for 10: API-based (programmatic) webhook registration/subscription management, an enumerated list of event types, payload signature verification and retry/delivery documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: To register a new webhook, you need to have a URL in your app that Teller can call. You can configure a new webhook from the Teller Dashboard
Teller sends webhook events when specific conditions or changes are detected in user enrollments or their financial data.
